hero.subtitle: Quality. Creativity. Lasting Results.
hero.description: Artistic murals · Epoxy flooring · Remodeling · Premium painting — built for homeowners, restaurants and commercial properties who refuse ordinary.

about.p1: CSD Good Services was born from a passion for transforming and elevating spaces. We began with residential painting and remodeling — and grew, project after project, into a full creative studio trusted by homeowners, restaurants, investors and commercial properties.
about.p2: Today we combine the precision of a contractor with the eye of an artist. Every brushstroke, every resin pour, every wall we touch is treated as a one-of-a-kind piece.
about.story_caption: From a single brush — to a full studio.
about.value_1_desc: Every detail is intentional. Every finish is built to last.
about.value_2_desc: Constant updates, clear timelines and zero surprises.
about.value_3_desc: Honest pricing. Respectful crews. Punctual deliveries.
about.value_4_desc: We don't paint walls — we design moments.

services.subtitle: From a single mural to a complete renovation — every project is led by senior craftsmen and curated with the same obsessive detail.

portfolio.subtitle: A curated selection of recent projects across Miami, Medley and beyond.
portfolio.no_projects: No projects in this category yet.

process.subtitle: We treat every project like a small film — with a script, a director and a flawless premiere.
process.step_1_desc: We listen. We visit the space. We translate your ideas into a creative brief.
process.step_2_desc: Detailed measurements, technical inspection and material sampling.
process.step_3_desc: A transparent, itemized quote — with timeline, materials and moodboard.
process.step_4_desc: Senior crew on site. Daily updates. Zero shortcuts.
process.step_5_desc: A walkthrough, a final reveal — and a space you'll want to live in.

testimonials.t1: CSD transformed our restaurant. The mural alone became the most photographed wall in Wynwood.
testimonials.t2: Professional, creative and punctual. Our epoxy floors look better than the showroom samples.
testimonials.t3: They treated our remodel like their own home. Rare to find that level of care.
